text:
maya: Starting a last-pass thread for the docs release notes & changelog (v0.14). Main items: migration guide for embed-streaming removal, unify SDK snippets, fix a few stale anchors, and a tiny known-issues section. Who can take publish? ping @taylor

taylor: I can run publish and assemble the shortblurb. Please get PR links in by EOD tomorrow. Also: avoid hard perf numbers in examples.

jess: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6012 -- migration guide plus small diffs on examples. I swapped `client.generate()` to `client.text.generate()` and added `// MIGRATE` comments. Needs a quick eye for tone.

rob: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6020 -- snippet parity (JS/Py) and anchor fixes. Replaced `kestrel:openai/compat` examples with `kestrel/v1`. Fixed a few anchors to /docs/perf/caching#kv-cache.

maya: Draft behavioral-change line: "Routing fallback now favors lower-latency compatible model variants; this may subtly change per-request outputs and tail-latency behavior." Keep it compact.

jess: Added a tiny YAML example in the migration PR showing policy differences:```yaml
route_policy:
  policy: latency
# vs
  policy: cost
```

taylor: Known-issues bullets (short): - Sidebar anchor TTL may present stale anchors for a short window after deploy. - embed-streaming removed: migrate to embeddings.v2 or contact SE for Dedicated help. - SDK: prefer explicit `text.generate` over legacy aliases.

docs-bot: Release checklist: 1) All PR links posted 2) Snippets smoke-tested 3) Changelog entry added to /changelogs/0.14.md 4) Known-issues included 5) Owner runs `/docs release-ready`.

maya: Smoke test reminder: run examples locally and paste `✅ snippet tested` here when done. Also remove any numeric ms/token values from sample outputs.

jess: ✅ snippet tested (JS + Py) -- switched outputs to mocked text and removed perf numbers.

rob: If we see any anchor 404s after merge, ping `@ops` and they can do a quick CDN/SSG invalidation.

taylor: I will open the changelog PR for /changelogs/0.14.md tomorrow morning and handle publish once merged. If you push changes after freeze, drop a one-line note to the changelog PR so I can fold it into the release notes. Thanks all. :rocket:
